label: Bible Study
prompt: And Peter went out, and wept _____.
verse: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
note: The rooster crowed, the Lord turned and looked at Peter — and these were his tears.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And God _____ Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
verse: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
note: After long years of waiting, God remembered Rachel — and Joseph was born.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And there arose a great _____ of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
verse: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
note: A great storm of wind, a boat filling with water — and Jesus asleep in the back on a pillow.

label: Deep Water
prompt: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from _____ into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.
verse: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.
note: The origin of Purim: Esther's people turned the day appointed for their destruction into a feast.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: _____ one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
verse: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
note: 'Forbearing one another' — putting up with each other — and forgiving, even as Christ forgave you.
